title: Sauna Glossary
subtitle: 145 sauna and bathhouse terms in 25 languages, with English meanings
description:
A multilingual glossary of sauna and bathhouse words: 145 terms in 25 languages. Each row gives the term in its own script, a transliteration where the script is not Latin, a short meaning in plain English, a category (place, room, heat source, steam, tool, practice, person, headwear, cooling, expression, food and drink) and the bathing tradition it belongs to. The tradition names match the Sauna Traditions of the World dataset, so the two can be joined.

Compiled and checked by hand; only terms that could be confirmed are included. It is a reference word list, not a complete dictionary. Version 1.0 (2026-11). Published by DIVELUX, makers of wool sauna hats: https://diveluxsaunahat.com/pages/sauna-tools

resources.description: The glossary: one row per term (145 rows, 8 columns), UTF-8.
